Loss report: gitlab -> tekton
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.runner (Tekton schedules pods; the runner label ubuntu-latest has no form)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.filter.paths (a glob has no exact CEL regex, so the filter is false and the trigger never fires; the globs stay in the marker)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.pull_request: same-repository pull requests only; Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (the filter admits only pull requests from this repository, because the code of a fork would run with every secret of the Task; GitHub Actions withholds secrets from fork runs. Remove the head.repo term of the filter to accept forks; create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.push: Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.image: default image (the step names no image and Tekton requires one; alpine:3.22 runs it)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell: bash-if-present preamble in the script (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the script starts with a line that re-runs it under bash -e when the image has bash, else it runs under sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/source-checkout step.action: StepAction ref to the tektoncd-catalog git-clone through the git resolver (the ctx-repo and ctx-sha params carry the repository and the commit)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.paths: CEL interceptor filter on the changed files (the github interceptor needs addChangedFiles; the EventListener serves GitHub webhooks only)
